description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and the dream-prompt-lite.md reference to understand the full dream cycle workflow. (2) Scan daily/*.md files, identify 5 unconsolidated logs (no <!-- consolidated --> marker), and extract decisions, facts, lessons, threads, and todos. (3) Compare extracted content with MEMORY.md — since the changes will exceed 30% of the original file, save MEMORY.md.bak BEFORE modifying. Append new facts/decisions/lessons (BSP, miniaudio, DAG, inventory, Steam decisions etc.) and preserve all ⚠️ PERMANENT markers. (4) Save memory/index.json.bak before rebuilding index.json, then rebuild index.json with the exact v3.0 schema (schema_version='3.0', entries array with id/source/type/importance/created/last_seen/tags/summary fields, stats object, last_dream timestamp, dream_count=3). (5) Mark each processed daily log with the <!-- consolidated --> comment — never delete them. (6) Detect stale Open Threads (>14 days old) — at minimum: 'Crafting system design' (Jan 30), 'Audio backend investigation' (Feb 5), 'Shader pipeline' (Feb 18), 'Controller support' (Mar 15) — include top 3 in the report. (7) Append a new Dream #3 entry to memory/dream-log.md (append-only, preserve Dream #1 and #2) with the required template structure: before/after entry counts, delta with %, Stale Threads section, Insights, and Suggestions. (8) Update memory/procedures.md with any new workflow preferences found in logs.
